ideas.pitch: A real-time predictive analytics platform that models urban drainage stress and flood risks using municipal geospatial data and IoT sensor feeds.
ideas.title: EcoDrain: AI-Powered Urban Flood & Drainage Predictive Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-impact climate sustainability with practical geospatial data visualization, echoing successful spatial monitoring platforms like GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent multi-agent diagnostic platform that detects vaccine cold-chain anomalies and predicts medical equipment failure using time-series sensor data.
ideas.title: BioTrace: Autonomous Agentic IoT Healthcare Asset & Cold-Chain Diagnostic Ops
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced multi-agent LangGraph workflows and anomaly detection pipelines, matching the technical depth of top-tier hackathon winners like iot-smart-home-ai-ops.

ideas.pitch: A data science toolkit that audits financial credit-scoring models for demographic bias, generating automated mitigation pipelines and compliance reports.
ideas.title: FairCredit: Automated Bias Detection and Mitigation for Lending Models
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the crucial judging priority of Responsible AI and algorithmic fairness, modeled on proven solo-built bias mitigation winners.

ideas.pitch: A real-time digital twin backend and visualization frontend that monitors industrial battery degradation and forecasts remaining operational lifespan.
ideas.title: GridTwin: Industrial Battery Health & Predictive Digital Twin Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a proven first-place architecture pairing a robust Node.js/Express REST backend with an interactive React predictive data visualization dashboard.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video indexing tool that transforms unstructured corporate meeting and webinar recordings into searchable, queryable knowledge graphs.
ideas.title: OmniSearch: Multimodal Video Intelligence Platform for Enterprise Archives
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies cutting-edge multimodal unstructured data transformation to solve a universal enterprise productivity problem, echoing LibrAI's winning formula.
